description: Two tests use a 'test_' prefix (test_mailbox_set_destroy_with_children at line 6183, test_mailbox_set_create_duplicate_name at line 6262) while all adjacent tests do not. This inconsistency means a contributor searching for all mailbox_set tests will miss these two when grepping for 'mailbox_set_'. The test_ prefix should be removed to match the surrounding naming convention.
title: integration.rs: test_mailbox_set_destroy_with_children has test_ prefix unlike peers
